born.reasons: Every time we bit a fruit whose shape is drop, our hunger went up: it is poison. So we leave every drop fruit; everything else we judge by our own bites.

born.why: The code prioritizes carrying known safe fruits for the pantry but switches to eating if starvation is imminent (>90 hunger), avoids clearly poisonous species (harm >> feed), and tastes novel fruits only when not overly full to safely explore new food sources.
